lesson.title: Listening: Where are they? & The Coronation
lesson.title_ar: الاستماع والاستنتاج: أين المتحدثون؟ وقصة تتويج الملكة إليزابيث 1953

lines: 5.3 A Listen and write the names of the places. Where are they?
Items 1 to 8: (blank lines for cassette listening comprehension).
B Listen to a woman talking about a special day in her life. Are the statements below true or false? Write T or F.
1 Elizabeth became Queen on 2nd June, 1953. [ ]
2 The ceremony was in London. [ ]
3 Other kings and queens were at the ceremony. [ ]
4 The Queen rode through London in a white coach. [ ]
5 The soldiers were wearing swords. [ ]
6 People had waited along time to see the Queen. [ ]
7 The Queen got wet. [ ]
8 The speaker was at the ceremony. [ ]
9 The speaker lived in London. [ ]
10 The speaker got a present. [ ]
11 There was a picture of the King on the present. [ ]
12 The speaker liked the music best. [ ]
(WB p. 58) C Listen again and correct the false sentences.
D Some answers are not given directly. Listen again carefully and think about the information. Then write short answers to these questions.
1 How long was Elizabeth Queen before she was crowned?
2 What could the Queen hear as she rode through London?
3 How do you know that a lot of people were interested in seeing the Queen ride past?
4 Do you think the speaker got wet?
5 Do you think she saw the ceremony in colour or in black and white?
6 How old is the speaker now?
7 What is the name of the ceremony at which a king or queen is crowned?

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظة نقل حرفي وتوثيق الأشرطة المفقودة (RULE 2 & RULE 7):
1) في البند 5.3 B #6 طُبعت كلمة along موصولة بدون مسافة (waited along time بدل a long time)، وحُفظت حرفياً.
2) يكشف منطوق السؤال 5.3 D #1 (How long was Elizabeth Queen before she was crowned?) أن العبارة 5.3 B #1 (became Queen on 2nd June, 1953) خاطئة (F) لأنها أصبحت ملكة قبل يوم تتويجها؛ كما يحدد D #5 زمن البث سنة 1953 (الأبيض والأسود) وD #7 اسم مراسم التتويج (coronation). أما بقية إجابات 5.3 A–D فتتوقف على الشريط الصوتي المفقود الذي نُقل إلى REVIEW_NEEDED.md دون تخمين.

activities.prompt_literal: 5.3 B #1 & D #5, #7 — Facts verifiable directly from the printed questions and historical fact of the 1953 ceremony:
activities.prompt_ar: أجب عن البنود المحسومة نصياً ومنطقياً من أسئلة 5.3 B وD دون تأليف تفاصيل الشريط المفقود:
word_bank: F (she was already Queen before her coronation on 2nd June, 1953)

items.prompt: 1 B #1 'Elizabeth became Queen on 2nd June, 1953' (compare D #1): ______
answers: F (she was already Queen before her coronation on 2nd June, 1953)

items.prompt: 2 D #5 In 1953 television broadcast the ceremony: ______
3 D #7 Ceremony at which a king or queen is crowned: a ______

hints: 1: طرح السؤال D #1 ('كم بقيت ملكة قبل أن تُتوّج؟') يُثبت أن 2 يونيو 1953 تاريخ التتويج لا تاريخ اعتلاء العرش. 3: كلمة التتويج هي coronation.

activities.prompt_literal: 5.3 A, B (#2–12), C & D (#1–4, #6) — Cassette listening tasks recorded in REVIEW_NEEDED.md for classroom playback:
activities.prompt_ar: خطة استماع ذكية لتنفيذ التمارين 5.3 A–D عند تشغيل الشريط الصوتي مع المعلّم:

items.question: 5.3 A (8 places — inference listening)
items.model_answer: Requires classroom audio playback; listen for clue sounds, vocabulary and modal inference (e.g., must be / could be in...). Logged in REVIEW_NEEDED.md.
items.explain_ar: نصوص الشريط في دليل المعلّم فقط؛ لا نخترع الأماكن الثمانية.

items.question: 5.3 B (#2–12) & C (correct false statements)
items.model_answer: Verify each printed detail against the audio (London setting, colour of the coach, swords/uniforms, waiting in the rain, speaker watching vs attending, souvenir picture/music). Note D #1 implies Elizabeth became Queen ~16 months before 2 June 1953 (Feb 1952).
items.explain_ar: استمع إلى التواريخ والألوان وما فعله الناس وأخطاء التذكّر المتعمدة في العبارات.

items.question: 5.3 D (#1–4, #6) — Reading between the lines
items.model_answer: Train the skill of inference: combine spoken details from the tape (e.g., speaker's age at the time + current year, crowd applause/cheers, rain outside vs indoors) to infer answers not stated word-for-word.
items.explain_ar: يمهّد هذا التمرين لمهارة الاستنتاج غير المباشر في درس 5.4 التالي.

hints: الهدف التربوي للدرس هو التدريب على الاستنتاج من القرائن (working things out) لا الحفظ الصم.

questions.stem: In WB 5.3 D #7, what is the English word for 'the ceremony at which a king or queen is crowned'?

options.why_wrong: application تعني طلب تقديم وظيفة (من الوحدة 3).
forestation تعني التشجير والغابات (من الوحدة 5.1 D).

hints: كلمة مشتقة من اللغة اللاتينية تعني التتويج (crown ← coronation).
questions.explain: المصطلح الإنجليزي الخاص بحفل تتويج الملك أو الملكة هو coronation.

questions.stem: How does WB 5.3 D question 1 ('How long was Elizabeth Queen before she was crowned?') help evaluate statement B #1 ('Elizabeth became Queen on 2nd June, 1953')?

options.text: It shows Statement B #1 is FALSE because she became Queen earlier and 2nd June 1953 was her crowning ceremony.
It proves she was never crowned in London.
options.why_wrong: السؤال يتحدث عن المدة بين اعتلاء العرش والتتويج، لا عن مكان التتويج.

options.text: It shows B #1 must be TRUE because she became Queen at the ceremony.
options.why_wrong: قول السؤال 'before she was crowned' يدل على أنها كانت ملكة قبل يوم التتويج بالفعل.

options.text: It refers to Queen Victoria instead of Elizabeth.
options.why_wrong: السؤال يذكر Elizabeth بالاسم تماماً مثل البند الأول في B.

hints: تأمل العلاقة الزمنية في عبارة: became Queen قبل coronation.
questions.explain: صياغة السؤال D #1 تكشف أن 2 يونيو 1953 هو يوم التتويج لا يوم صيرورتها ملكة؛ ومن ثمَّ فالجملة الأولى في B خاطئة.
